describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background, standing on four stout limbs. It has an elongated, tapering snout with a dark nostril at the tip, a small dark eye, and a low, arched body almost entirely covered in overlapping large, rounded keratinous scales that are dark brown with tan edges and interspersed with patches of pale pink scales on the flanks, shoulder and mid-back. The head is small relative to the body, the tail is thick and tapering and extends to the left, and six prominent pink, feathery external gill stalks protrude from the sides and top of the head and neck behind the eye and ear region. The skin on the snout, lower neck and limbs is wrinkled and brownish-gray, and the feet bear curved claws.

describe.description: A quadrupedal scaly creature shown in right-side profile walking to the right. It has a long low body covered in overlapping rounded brown scales with patches of pale pink scales on the flank and shoulder, a long tapered scaly tail extending to the left, four short sturdy legs with broad clawed feet, and an elongated pointed head with a narrow snout, small dark eye, and dark ear opening. Behind each side of the head are three pink feathery external gill stalks with fine filaments, three visible on the near side and three tips visible above the top of the head on the far side.
